home.noFieldBody: Mark your land on the map to get crop advice made for your soil and weather.
home.todayTasks: Work for the next few days
home.noTasks: No work due. Choose a crop to get a work calendar.

alerts.title: Weather alerts
alerts.heavy_rain: Heavy rain ({{mm}} mm) expected on {{date}}. Clear field drains and do not spray or apply fertilizer.
alerts.rain: Rain ({{mm}} mm) expected on {{date}}. Skip irrigation and postpone spraying.
alerts.heat: Heatwave: {{temp}}°C on {{date}}. Irrigate in the evening and protect young plants.
alerts.cold: Cold night: {{temp}}°C on {{date}}. A light irrigation helps protect crops.
alerts.frost: Frost risk: {{temp}}°C on {{date}}. Irrigate lightly in the evening and cover nurseries.
alerts.wind: Strong wind ({{kmh}} km/h) on {{date}}. Do not spray; support tall crops.

field.instructions: Tap each corner of your field on the map (at least 3).
field.walkingHint: Walk slowly along your field boundary. Tap Stop when you are back at the start.
field.name: Field name
field.needPoints: Mark at least 3 corners, or use your location.
field.locationDenied: Location permission is off. You can still tap on the map.
field.analysing: Checking soil and weather for your field…
field.soilEstimateNote: This is an estimate, not a soil test. Add your Soil Health Card for better advice.
field.recommending: AI is studying your soil, weather and mandi prices… (about 30 seconds)
field.deleteConfirm: Delete this field and all its data?

soil.title: Soil details
soil.scanHint: Take a clear photo of the results table on your card.
soil.manualHint: Or type values from your soil test. Leave blank if you don't know.

reco.title: Crop advice
reco.disclaimer: AI advice and profits are estimates. Check with your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra before big decisions.

assistant.title: Ask KrishiMitra
assistant.welcome: Namaste! Ask me anything about crops, soil, weather, pests or government schemes. You can type, speak, or send a photo.
assistant.photoAttached: Photo will be sent with your question
assistant.voiceUnavailable: Voice is not set up yet. You can use the mic on your keyboard.

suggestions.s1: Which fertilizer should I use now?
suggestions.s2: Leaves are turning yellow. What should I do?

diagnose.title: Check crop disease
diagnose.instructions: Take a clear, close photo of the sick leaf or plant in daylight.
diagnose.consultExpert: Please show this to your nearest KVK or call Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551.
diagnose.notPlant: This does not look like a crop photo.

market.title: Market
market.empty: No prices found. Try All India or another crop.
market.notConfigured: Live mandi prices are not connected yet. Showing saved prices.

profile.helpline: Need help? Call Kisan Call Centre (free):

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No internet connection. Please try again.
errors.daily_limit: You have reached today's limit. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.ai_busy: AI is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
errors.ai_error: AI service had a problem. Please try again.
errors.ai_refused: Sorry, I can't help with that. Please ask about farming.
errors.ai_truncated: The answer was too long. Please try again.
errors.no_suitable_crops: No suitable crops found for this season. Try another season.
errors.not_soil_card: This does not look like a Soil Health Card. Please retake the photo.
errors.speech_not_configured: Voice is not set up yet. You can use the mic on your keyboard.
errors.stt_failed: Could not understand. Please speak again clearly.
errors.ai_not_configured: AI is not set up on the server yet. Please add the Gemini API key.
errors.not_farm_photo: These photos do not show a field or crop. Please take photos of your farm.

value.title: Crop value estimate
value.intro: Take photos of your field and crop. AI will tell the land type, crop condition and how much it may be worth.
value.photoHint: Take one wide photo of the field and one close photo of the plants.
value.analysing: AI is checking your photos… (about 30 seconds)
value.noValue: No standing crop seen, so no value estimate. Land details are shown above.
value.disclaimer: This is an AI estimate from photos. Real yield and price can differ.

produce.emptyBody: Be the first to list your crop for buyers.
produce.fromValuation: AI value of your crop: {{low}} – {{high}}. Quantity and price are filled from it; change them if you want.
produce.phoneVisible: Buyers will see this name and number so they can contact you directly.
produce.waMessage: Namaste, I saw your {{crop}} ({{qty}} quintal) on KrishiMitra. Is it still available?
produce.offerSent: Offer sent. The farmer will contact you.
produce.noOffers: No offers yet. Buyers can also call you directly.
produce.waReply: Namaste, this is about your offer for my {{crop}} on KrishiMitra.
